Name: DGR-010 - SKOFNUNG
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: DGR-10 SKOFNUNG was created in an attempt to imbue fiendish qualities into a DGR unit, constructing a DGR that many at the time considered to be cursed. These attempts were made to try and compensate for the diminishing materials required to make the General-Class DGRs. Once the unit was created, it was found that it had dark intentions of its own: the devilish magic imbued into it and its remarkable greatsword led to it seizing control from its pilots, as well as turning against other DGR units who showed great combat proficiency. It was deemed to be a lustful machine that desired strong opponents, and so it was retired and sealed away rather than be deployed during the War in One Moment. However, while the other DGRs were blown from the sky and as many as possible were salvaged, SKOFNUNG was unsealed by an unknown faction and was either stolen or escaped. Its location was never discovered after this.

Any creature that fails the save by 5 points or more is also cursed for 1 minute, and while cursed this way they become sluggish. If the targets are DGRs, their pilots are also cursed while the DGR is. At the end of each target’s turn they make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw, ending the curse on themselves on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Dark Shroud (2/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The DGR chooses a point or creature it can see within 240 feet, and creates a light-refracting veil around that point or creature that causes a 30-foot-radius sphere of darkness to appear, centered on them. If targeting a creature, the target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or have the veil pinned to them, causing it to move with them. The veil remains for 1 minute, until the DGR dispels it as a bonus action, or until the DGR is incapacitated.
